about: T-434 and T-435 (2026-10-21): SIX ISLAND WATER PATH's grove door moved into the channel (surf up to the new rock, into the grove, out by its lone tree into the channel; THE NEXUS's door 12 in and out), and the S.S. ANNE pier's boardwalk (the fir walked to from VERMILION and back, with the ship in port by DEBUG's FIR IN PORT, and after she sails by FIR). Debug scratch save. The walker's `to` overshoots while surfing (a 12-frame hold carries a surfer two tiles), so on water this route holds: the rock itself stops the surfer below it.
